title: Ray-finned fishes: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (ray-finned fishes).

questions.prompt: To which family does the Black Mullet (Mugil cephalus) belong?
questions.explain: The Black Mullet (Mugil cephalus) belongs to the family Mugilidae, order Perciformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Giant Tigerfish (Hydrocynus goliath) belong?
questions.explain: The Giant Tigerfish (Hydrocynus goliath) belongs to the family Alestidae, order Characiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Humphead wrasse (Cheilinus undulatus) belong?
questions.explain: The Humphead wrasse (Cheilinus undulatus) belongs to the family Labridae, order Labriformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the American paddlefish (Polyodon spathula) belong?
questions.explain: The American paddlefish (Polyodon spathula) belongs to the family paddlefish, order Acipenseriformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the kissing gourami (Helostoma temminckii) belong?
questions.explain: The kissing gourami (Helostoma temminckii) belongs to the family Helostomatidae, order Anabantiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the European smelt (Osmerus eperlanus) belong?
questions.explain: The European smelt (Osmerus eperlanus) belongs to the family Osmeridae, order Osmeriformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the electric eel (Electrophorus electricus) belong?
questions.explain: The electric eel (Electrophorus electricus) belongs to the family Gymnotidae, order Gymnotiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Great barracuda (Sphyraena barracuda) belong?
questions.explain: The Great barracuda (Sphyraena barracuda) belongs to the family Sphyraenidae, order Carangiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Mandarinfish (Synchiropus splendidus) belong?
questions.explain: The Mandarinfish (Synchiropus splendidus) belongs to the family Callionymidae, order Perciformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the African Electric Catfish (Malapterurus electricus) belong?
questions.explain: The African Electric Catfish (Malapterurus electricus) belongs to the family electric catfish, order Siluriformes.
